challenge.method: Compared matching spellings in the VB6 and VB2005 columns. Checked the proposed VB2005 reading against Microsoft's dated release naming (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/visual-basic/whats-new/) and the possible confusion with Office VBA or platform-sized aliases (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/language/concepts/getting-started/64-bit-visual-basic-for-applications-overview).
challenge.results: Reading across the correct columns confirms both CLR identities. VB6 spells the signed 32-bit type Long, and the VBA reference separates pointer-sized LongPtr and 64-bit LongLong. These are distinct identities despite the shared words.

limitations: This is the archive's Visual Basic 2005 table. It supports no statement about the ABI or other editions that use corresponding CLR names.
